name: Lee Kum Kee Premium Oyster Flavored Sauce
whyItWorks: Made from true oyster extracts simmered until caramelized and thickened with modified corn starch. It has a silky smooth consistency with zero fiber, providing rich savory flavor for plain rice and noodles.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stir 1 tablespoon into cooked white rice, soft noodles, or steamed baby carrots and chicken.
watchOuts: Rich in flavor; a small spoonful goes a long way.
